content: Finally, we obtain 2,337 sentences for EC-MT and 2,300 for EC-UQ. Table 1 shows the information of annotated results. Similarly, we produce the development and test datasets for system evaluation, by randomly selecting 400 sentences and letting two experts to generate the groundtruth annotations. Among them, we use 100 sentences as the development set and the remaining 300 as the test set. The rest sentences with only crowdsourcing annotations are used as the training set.
